approved_architecture_decisions: Use immutable experiment protocols and per-run manifests with stable-request idempotency.
Use one protocol-global cross-run provider lease and one model/reasoning profile for initial comparisons.
Give single_codex only the original task contract and direct access to an independently sanitized repository.
Use independent Git object stores plus bwrap canary enforcement for clean reset and blind-gold isolation.
Enforce token and wall-time budgets only at provider and integration safe boundaries with visible one-call overshoot.
Keep recovery snapshots separate from fsynced, atomically published, immutable terminal result bundles.
Store operator actions in an append-only closed-vocabulary ledger and require epoch-bound live authorization.
Require deterministic calibration to retain completed, failed, infrastructure_failed, interrupted, and budget_stopped result bundles.
Require P2-08 to parse the canonical deterministic calibration report and bind it to the validated code commit.
Complete the zero-call pilot guard before journaling the complete P2-08 action and registering it against the refreshed R epoch.
Complete the implementation taskpack under the preflight release, then install the reviewed candidate release before freezing a controller-only promotion taskpack.
resolved_contradictions: Corrected the P2-06 exact write-scope cardinality from 13 to 14.
Replaced digest-only deterministic calibration acceptance with canonical report validation and source-commit binding.
Expanded readiness recomputation to cover budget warning, exhaustion, overshoot, accepted-patch preservation, operator input normalization, recovery snapshots, and result projection.
Required deterministic calibration to retain every terminal outcome named by the Phase 2 capability-promotion contract.
Aligned the P2-08 document order with the recoverable implementation by completing the pilot guard before publishing the action journal, refreshed epoch, and receipt.
Separated deterministic unit calibration from the dedicated real-systemd integration tests so ordinary verification does not hang on transient-service availability.
notes: Operator-approved immutable replacement for review.v1. The historical review remains unchanged because it binds earlier plan and blueprint bytes.
